desc.en: Free project management and SCRUM software for up to 5 team members
desc.zh: 免费的项目管理与 SCRUM 软件，最多支持 5 名团队成员。

desc.en: Free for private project with collaborators
desc.zh: 与协作者共同开展的私有项目可免费使用。

desc.en: Everything your team needs to release great projects in one platform. The free plan offers 1 Project with ten users & 100MB of storage.
desc.zh: 团队发布优质项目所需的一切尽在一个平台。免费套餐提供 1 个项目、10 名用户和 100MB 存储。

desc.en: To-do lists, milestone management, forum-like messaging, file sharing, and time tracking. Up to 3 projects, 20 users, and 1GB of storage space.
desc.zh: 待办清单、里程碑管理、论坛式消息、文件共享和时间追踪。最多 3 个项目、20 名用户和 1GB 存储空间。

desc.en: Intranet and project management tool. The free plan has 5GB for unlimited users.
desc.zh: 内联网与项目管理工具。免费套餐为不限数量的用户提供 5GB 空间。

desc.en: Online real-time diagrams: flowchart, UML, network. Free max. 15 users/diagram, 25 sheets
desc.zh: 在线实时图表：流程图、UML、网络图。免费版每个图表最多 15 名用户、25 个图纸。

desc.en: Project management. Free, premium version with cloud storage. Mobile applications and Git integrations are available.
desc.zh: 项目管理。免费，高级版附带云存储。提供移动应用和 Git 集成。

desc.en: Time tracker and timesheet app that lets you track work hours across projects. Unlimited users, free forever.
desc.zh: 时间追踪器与工时表应用，可跨项目追踪工作时长。用户数量不限，永久免费。

desc.en: Design a professional architecture diagram in minutes with the Cloudcraft visual designer, optimized for AWS with intelligent components that show live data too. Free plan has unlimited private diagrams for single user.
desc.zh: 使用 Cloudcraft 可视化设计器在几分钟内绘制专业架构图；它为 AWS 优化，智能组件还可展示实时数据。免费套餐支持单用户创建不限数量的私有图表。

desc.en: Atlassian's content collaboration tool is used to help teams collaborate and share knowledge efficiently. Free plan for up to 10 users.
desc.zh: Atlassian 的内容协作工具，帮助团队高效协作与共享知识。免费套餐最多支持 10 名用户。

desc.en: Versatile project management platform. Free for up to 3 projects, unlimited users, 1 GB storage.
desc.zh: 多功能项目管理平台。免费支持最多 3 个项目、不限用户数、1 GB 存储。

desc.en: Online diagrams stored locally in Google Drive, OneDrive, or Dropbox. Free for all features and storage levels
desc.zh: 在线图表，可本地存储于 Google Drive、OneDrive 或 Dropbox。所有功能和存储级别均免费。

desc.en: Simple and intuitive sprint retrospective tool. The free plan has three public boards and one survey per board per month.
desc.zh: 简单直观的冲刺回顾工具。免费套餐包含 3 个公开看板，每个看板每月 1 次调查。

desc.en: tasks, discussions, milestones, time tracking, calendar, files and password manager. Free plan with unlimited projects, users, and file storage.
desc.zh: 任务、讨论、里程碑、时间追踪、日历、文件和密码管理器。免费套餐支持不限数量的项目、用户和文件存储。

desc.en: Project Management and issue Tracking toolset for complex projects with self-premises and SaaS options. SaaS free plan offers the first five users free & free for Open Source Projects.
desc.zh: 面向复杂项目的项目管理与议题追踪工具集，支持本地部署和 SaaS 选项。SaaS 免费套餐为前 5 名用户免费，开源项目也可免费使用。

desc.en: Free description-to-diagrams tool for developers. Create informal UML class, object, or entity-relationship diagrams using your keyword.
desc.zh: 面向开发者的免费描述转图表工具。用关键词即可创建非正式的 UML 类图、对象图或实体关系图。

desc.en: GraphQL Inspector outputs a list of changes between two GraphQL schemas. Every difference is precisely explained and marked as breaking, non-breaking, or dangerous.
desc.zh: GraphQL Inspector 可输出两个 GraphQL schema 之间的变更列表。每处差异都有精确说明，并标记为破坏性、非破坏性或危险。

desc.en: Customer support software that offers a live chat on the free forever plan. Simple, lightweight and beautiful. Setup is a simple copy-paste script. Built by a developer.
desc.zh: 客户支持软件，永久免费套餐提供在线客服聊天功能。简单、轻量、美观。安装只需复制粘贴一段脚本。由开发者打造。

desc.en: Real-time sprint retrospective platform with voting, timers, surveys, guest collaboration, and ice-breaker games. The forever-free plan includes one board per month, anonymous surveys, and guest link sharing.
desc.zh: 实时冲刺回顾平台，具备投票、计时器、调查、访客协作和破冰游戏。永久免费套餐每月含 1 个看板、匿名调查和访客链接分享。

desc.en: Project management platform. The free plan offers unlimited users, projects & boards with 100 MB of Storage.
desc.zh: 项目管理平台。免费套餐支持不限数量的用户、项目和看板，含 100 MB 存储。

desc.en: interactive diagrams that allow users to see their infrastructure from multiple perspectives and levels of detail. Charts can be expressed in code. The free tier has unlimited private diagrams with up to 3 viewers.
desc.zh: 交互式图表，让用户从多个视角和细节层级查看其基础设施。图表可用代码表达。免费套餐支持不限数量的私有图表，最多 3 名查看者。

desc.en: Advanced software development project management tool used in many corporate environments. Free plan for up to 10 users.
desc.zh: 先进的软件开发项目管理工具，广泛用于各类企业环境。免费套餐最多支持 10 名用户。

desc.en: A powerful, flexible kanban app that helps you organise work, track progress, and deliver results-all in one place. Free plan up to 1 user for unlimited boards, unlimited lists, unlimited cards.
desc.zh: 强大、灵活的看板应用，帮助你在一处组织工作、追踪进度并交付成果。免费套餐支持 1 名用户创建不限数量的看板、列表和卡片。

desc.en: Board-based project management. Free, premium version with more options
desc.zh: 基于看板的项目管理。免费，高级版提供更多选项。

desc.en: Kanban board-based project management. The free plan has two boards and two users, without attachments or files.
desc.zh: 基于看板的项目管理。免费套餐含 2 个看板和 2 名用户，不支持附件或文件。

desc.en: Collaborate through all phases of the product development process and keep track of work across Slack, Discord, Figma, and Github. Unlimited users, unlimited spaces. Free plan up to 250 work items.
desc.zh: 在产品开发流程的所有阶段协作，并跨 Slack、Discord、Figma 和 Github 追踪工作。用户和空间数量不限。免费套餐最多 250 个工作项。

desc.en: Let anyone organize their job search and track interviews, opportunities, and connections. Powerful web app and Chrome extension. Completely free.
desc.zh: 帮助任何人整理求职信息，追踪面试、机会和人脉。功能强大的 Web 应用和 Chrome 扩展。完全免费。

desc.en: Relationship maps with animation, decorations, filters, clustering, spreadsheet imports, etc. The free tier allows unlimited public projects. Graph size unlimited. Free private projects for students. Sandbox mode is available if you prefer not to leave your file publicly online (upload, edit, download, discard).
desc.zh: 关系图谱，支持动画、装饰、过滤器、聚类、电子表格导入等。免费套餐允许不限数量的公开项目，图大小不限。学生可免费创建私有项目。如果你不希望文件公开在线，可使用沙盒模式（上传、编辑、下载、丢弃）。

desc.en: Leiga is a SaaS product that uses AI to automatically manage your projects, helping your team stay focused and unleash immense potential, ensuring your projects progress as planned. Free for up to 10 users, 20 custom fields, 2GB of storage space, Video Recording with AI limited to 5 mins/video, Automation Runs at 20/user/month.
desc.zh: Leiga 是一款利用 AI 自动管理项目的 SaaS 产品，帮助团队保持专注、释放巨大潜力，确保项目按计划推进。免费支持最多 10 名用户、20 个自定义字段、2GB 存储空间；AI 视频录制每个视频限 5 分钟，自动化运行为每用户每月 20 次。

desc.en: Issue tracker with a streamlined interface. Free for unlimited members, up to 10MB file upload size, 250 issues (excluding Archive)
desc.zh: 界面简洁流畅的议题追踪工具。免费支持不限成员数，文件上传大小最高 10MB，250 个议题（不含归档）。

desc.en: An online diagram tool with collaboration features. Free plan with three editable documents, 100 professional templates, and basic collaboration features.
desc.zh: 具备协作功能的在线图表工具。免费套餐含 3 个可编辑文档、100 个专业模板和基础协作功能。

desc.en: Online task management for teams. Free up to 3 projects and unlimited project members.
desc.zh: 面向团队的在线任务管理。免费支持最多 3 个项目和不限数量的项目成员。

desc.en: Free online scrum tool with kanban board
desc.zh: 免费的在线 scrum 工具，带看板。

desc.en: Spec-Driven Development (SDD) architect tool that interviews developers and generates structured 4-file spec bundles with MCP server integration. Free tier covers 20 projects and 100 spec files.
desc.zh: 规格驱动开发（SDD）架构工具，通过访谈开发者生成结构化的 4 文件规格包，并集成 MCP 服务器。免费套餐支持 20 个项目和 100 个规格文件。

desc.en: Project management software that enables your teams to collaborate, plan, analyze, and manage everyday tasks. The essential plan is free forever with 100 MB storage and five users/teams. Unlimited workspaces, meetings, assignments, timesheets, and issue tracking.
desc.zh: 项目管理软件，让团队能够协作、规划、分析和管理日常任务。基础套餐永久免费，含 100 MB 存储和 5 名用户/团队。工作区、会议、任务分配、工时表和议题追踪数量不限。

desc.en: Plane is a simple, extensible, open-source project and product management tool. Free for unlimited members, up to 5MB file upload size, 1000 issues.
desc.zh: Plane 是一款简单、可扩展的开源项目与产品管理工具。免费支持不限成员数，文件上传大小最高 5MB，1,000 个议题。

desc.en: Free online planning poker (estimation tool)
desc.zh: 免费的在线计划扑克（估算工具）。

desc.en: Online Planning Poker (consensus-based estimation tool). Free for unlimited users, teams, sessions, rounds, and votes. You don't need to register.
desc.zh: 在线计划扑克（基于共识的估算工具）。免费支持不限数量的用户、团队、会议、轮次和投票。无需注册。

desc.en: Free Minimalistic Time Tracker and Timesheet app for projects.
desc.zh: 免费的极简项目时间追踪与工时表应用。

desc.en: Scrum board with a very intuitive interface, free up to 5 users.
desc.zh: 界面非常直观的 Scrum 看板，免费支持最多 5 名用户。

desc.en: sflow.io is a project management tool built for agile software development, marketing, sales, and customer support, especially for outsourcing and cross-organization collaboration projects. Free plan up to 3 projects and five members.
desc.zh: sflow.io 是为敏捷软件开发、市场营销、销售和客户支持打造的项目管理工具，尤其适合外包和跨组织协作项目。免费套餐最多 3 个项目和 5 名成员。

desc.en: In-app bug reporting and feedback tool for mobile apps. Free plan, ten bug reports per app/month.
desc.zh: 面向移动应用的应用内缺陷报告与反馈工具。免费套餐每个应用每月 10 份缺陷报告。

desc.en: Project management platform. Free for up to 10 users forever.
desc.zh: 项目管理平台。免费支持最多 10 名用户，永久有效。

desc.en: Project management platform for startups and agile developers, free for Open Source
desc.zh: 面向初创公司和敏捷开发者的项目管理平台，对开源项目免费。

desc.en: Real-time collaborative task lists and team outlines. The free plan has one workspace with unlimited tasks and projects; 1GB file storage; 1-week project history; and five attendees per video meeting.
desc.zh: 实时协作的任务清单和团队大纲。免费套餐含 1 个工作区，任务和项目数量不限；1GB 文件存储；1 周项目历史；每次视频会议最多 5 名参会者。

desc.en: Standup, retro, and sprint planning tool for remote teams. Free for up to 15 users.
desc.zh: 面向远程团队的站会、回顾会和冲刺规划工具。免费支持最多 15 名用户。

desc.en: Project management & Team Chat. Free for five users and two projects. Premium plans are available.
desc.zh: 项目管理与团队聊天。免费支持 5 名用户和 2 个项目。提供高级套餐。

desc.en: Simple and fun retrospective tool with icebreakers, gifs and emojis. The free plan includes three retros and unlimited members.
desc.zh: 简单有趣的回顾工具，带破冰环节、GIF 和表情符号。免费套餐含 3 次回顾和不限成员数。

desc.en: Lightweight project management tool for agile teams. The SaaS relies on free contributions; users can always choose to give 0 and there is no features paywall {[more details](https://tenzu.net/pricing/)}
desc.zh: 面向敏捷团队的轻量级项目管理工具。该 SaaS 依靠自愿付费贡献维持；用户始终可以选择支付 0，且不存在功能付费墙。{[更多详情](https://tenzu.net/pricing/)}

desc.en: productivity tools for Jira and monday.com offering structured checklists, templates, and approvals inside issues/tasks. Free plan available for small teams.
desc.zh: 面向 Jira 和 monday.com 的效率工具，在议题/任务中提供结构化清单、模板和审批。小团队可使用免费套餐。

desc.en: Collaborative and individual task management. The free plan has: 5 active projects, five users in the project, file uploading up to 5MB, three filters, and one week of activity history.
desc.zh: 协作式与个人任务管理。免费套餐包含：5 个活动项目、每个项目 5 名用户、最高 5MB 文件上传、3 个过滤器以及 1 周活动历史。

desc.en: Provides two free productivity tools. [Toggl Track](https://toggl.com/track/) for time management and tracking app with a free plan provides seamless time tracking and reporting designed with freelancers in mind. It has unlimited tracking records, projects, clients, tags, reporting, and more. And [Toggl Plan](https://toggl.com/plan/) for task planning with a free plan for solo developers with unlimited tasks, milestones, and timelines.
desc.zh: 提供两款免费效率工具。[Toggl Track](https://toggl.com/track/) 是时间管理与追踪应用，其免费套餐专为自由职业者设计，提供流畅的时间追踪与报告，追踪记录、项目、客户、标签、报告等数量不限。[Toggl Plan](https://toggl.com/plan/) 用于任务规划，其免费套餐面向独立开发者，任务、里程碑和时间线数量不限。

desc.en: Board-based project management. Unlimited Personal Boards, 10 Team Boards.
desc.zh: 基于看板的项目管理。个人看板数量不限，10 个团队看板。

desc.en: Simple Weekly To-Do Calendar & Task Management.
desc.zh: 简单的每周待办日历与任务管理工具。

desc.en: Product designing Service with Projects, VCS & Issues. The free plan offers unlimited projects & collaborators and 3GB storage.
desc.zh: 产品设计服务，包含项目、版本控制系统（VCS）和议题。免费套餐支持不限数量的项目与协作者，含 3GB 存储。

desc.en: Agile development and issue tracking. Free up to 3 users, unlimited projects.
desc.zh: 敏捷开发与议题追踪。免费支持最多 3 名用户，项目数量不限。

desc.en: Free hosted YouTrack (InCloud) for FOSS projects and private projects (free for three users). Includes time tracking and agile boards
desc.zh: 为 FOSS 项目和私有项目提供免费托管 YouTrack（InCloud）（3 名用户免费）。包含时间追踪和敏捷看板。

desc.en: The only project management solution inside GitHub. Free for public repos, OSS, and nonprofit organizations
desc.zh: GitHub 内唯一的项目管理解决方案。公共仓库、OSS 和非营利组织可免费使用。

desc.en: Project management and collaboration tool. Free for up to 5 members, 5 GB attachments.
desc.zh: 项目管理与协作工具。免费支持最多 5 名成员、5 GB 附件。

desc.en: Project management with free plan for 4 Projects & 4 users. GitHub integration is available.
desc.zh: 项目管理，免费套餐支持 4 个项目和 4 名用户。提供 GitHub 集成。
